process_area.title: HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations

value_stream.name: HR Shared Services, Employee Experience & People Analytics

fields.Participants: HRSS team, Employees, Managers, HR Business Partners, Subject experts

workflows.name: Employee Service Center (HR Helpdesk) Case Intake, Triage & Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "create case in case-management system" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route Tier-2/3 to the right specialist" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate, and close the case" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: omnichannel case intake; operational: Tier-1 empowerment and knowledge base (W3331)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-fragmentation risk**: Requests scattered across channels get lost; mitigated by omnichannel case intake
- **First-contact-resolution risk**: Low FCR inflates cost and frustrates employees; mitigated by Tier-1 empowerment and knowledge base (W3331)
System Touchpoints: - Case management; HRIS/ESS (links to VS-29.2/VS-103.1); knowledge base; payroll (links to VS-19.2); benefits (links to VS-102)

steps.activity: HRSS team intake the request via channel (portal links to VS-103.1, phone, email, in-person at store/DC/HQ): capture employee identity, category (pay links to VS-19.2, benefits VS-102, leave, policy, lifecycle), and urgency; create case in case-management system

HRSS team triage: resolve Tier-1 (policy, status lookups, simple transactions) at first contact; route Tier-2/3 to the right specialist (payroll VS-19.2, C&B VS-102, HRBP, legal VS-100, IT VS-27) with context; set SLA and acknowledge
HRSS team/specialist resolve, validate, and close the case; update knowledge base (W3331), notify the employee/manager, and capture CSAT (W3336); track reopen and aging

fields.Participants: HRSS team, HR Technology (links to VS-103.3), IT (links to VS-27), Payroll (links to VS-19.2)

workflows.name: Employee Self-Service (ESS) & Manager Self-Service (MSS) Portal Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "technology operate the ESS/MSS portal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "HRSS team support adoption" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track adoption/usage analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: enablement and mobile-friendly design; operational: workflow approvals (links to VS-29)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-adoption risk**: Store staff not using self-service inflates helpdesk load; mitigated by enablement and mobile-friendly design
- **Data-error risk**: Self-service updates without validation corrupt master data; mitigated by workflow approvals (links to VS-29)
System Touchpoints: - ESS/MSS portal; HRIS (links to VS-29.2); payroll (links to VS-19.2); IT service (links to VS-27); access/security (links to VS-27.3)

steps.activity: HRSS/HR Technology operate the ESS/MSS portal: personal data updates, payslip/view (links to VS-19.2), leave requests/approvals, benefits enrollment (links to VS-102), time/attendance views (links to VS-19.3), directory, policy/knowledge access

HRSS team support adoption: training, in-store enablement for 5,800 store staff (low tech-literacy segments per profile §17), issue resolution, and feedback; manage access provisioning and role-based security (links to VS-27.3)

HR Technology/IT maintain portal integration (payroll, benefits, attendance, master data links to VS-29), push enhancements, monitor uptime/performance (links to VS-27), and track adoption/usage analytics

fields.Participants: HRSS team, HRBP, Subject experts, Comms (links to VS-103.2)

workflows.name: HR Case Management, Knowledge Base & Tiered Escalation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review case trends, identify knowledge gaps" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: review cadence tied to policy change; operational: taxonomy and Tier-1 empowerment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-knowledge risk**: Outdated articles mislead and rework; mitigated by review cadence tied to policy change
- **Escalation-bottleneck risk**: Poor tier design overloads specialists; mitigated by taxonomy and Tier-1 empowerment
System Touchpoints: - Case/knowledge-base platform; HRIS/policy (links to VS-29.2/VS-102); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: HRSS team maintain the case taxonomy (categories, sub-categories, SLA, routing rules, templates) and the tier model (Tier-1 self-service/helpdesk, Tier-2 specialist, Tier-3 HRBP/expert) with clear escalation triggers

HRSS/SME maintain the HR knowledge base: policy articles, FAQs, how-to guides (leave, benefits, payroll), localized for store/DC/HQ; keep current with policy change (links to VS-102/VS-84) and regulatory change (links to VS-22.3)
HRSS team review case trends, identify knowledge gaps (recurring questions → new article) and process improvements, and feed analytics to SLA/CSAT monitoring (W3336) and process excellence (W3352)

fields.Participants: HRSS team, Entity HR leads, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Cross-entity shared services (links to VS-72)
fields.Trigger: Employee request spans entities; entity change

workflows.name: Multi-Entity HR Shared Services Delivery & Cross-Entity Case Routing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "center, with entity-specific policy/config awareness" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route cross-entity cases correctly" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-allocate of "allocate shared-services cost to entities per the shared-services model" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: entity-aware routing; operational: clear model (links to VS-72)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misrouting risk**: Wrong-entity handling causes payroll/benefits errors; mitigated by entity-aware routing
- **Cost-allocation-dispute risk**: Entities dispute shared-services charges; mitigated by clear model (links to VS-72)
System Touchpoints: - Case management (entity-aware); cross-entity chargeback (links to VS-72); payroll (links to VS-19.2); HRIS (links to VS-29.2)

steps.activity: HRSS team deliver shared HR services across all 5 entities (Holdings, Depot, Logistics, Digital Commerce, Property Mgmt per profile §2) from a central service center, with entity-specific policy/config awareness

HRSS team route cross-entity cases correctly: identify the employee's employing entity, apply entity-specific policy/payroll/benefits (links to VS-19.2/VS-102), and coordinate inter-entity transfers (links to VS-72); maintain entity-aware case routing rules
HR Shared Services Mgr/Finance allocate shared-services cost to entities per the shared-services model (links to VS-72.1) and report entity-level service performance (W3336) and SLA

fields.Participants: HRSS team, Records (links to VS-88), Legal (links to VS-100), Data Privacy (links to VS-91), IT (links to VS-27)
fields.Trigger: Hire; policy acknowledgment; contract update; audit

workflows.name: Employee Document Management, e-Signature & HR Records

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "HRSS team maintain the employee document repository" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "HRSS team operate e-signature for offer letters" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: access controls and DSAR process; operational: records discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy-breach risk**: Mishandled employee records trigger NPC liability (links to VS-91); mitigated by access controls and DSAR process
- **Records-loss risk**: Lost/uncontrolled documents fail audit/litigation (links to VS-21/VS-100); mitigated by records discipline
System Touchpoints: - Document/e-signature platform; records/retention (links to VS-88); privacy (links to VS-91); legal hold (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: HRSS team maintain the employee document repository (contracts, policy acknowledgments, certifications, performance docs, disciplinary records) with version control, access control, and retention per records policy (links to VS-88)
HRSS team operate e-signature for offer letters (links to VS-19.1), policy acknowledgments, and HR forms; manage legal-hold suspension (links to VS-88 W2990/VS-100) and audit trails

HRSS team/Data Privacy ensure employee-data handling per Data Privacy Act (links to VS-91): access on need-to-know, DSAR fulfillment (links to VS-91.1), secure disposal at retention end, and breach response (links to VS-91.3)

fields.Participants: HRSS team, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Employees, Third parties (banks, government)

workflows.name: HR Transaction Processing (Verifications, Certifications, Employment Letters)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "reference checks (with consent)" completion (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of updates to the employee record with audit trail (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-123 (ensure HR service delivery & people-data accuracy.)
- operational: authorization controls; operational: consent workflow
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Unauthorized/falsified employment letters enable loan fraud; mitigated by authorization controls
- **Privacy risk**: Sharing employee data without consent (links to VS-91); mitigated by consent workflow
System Touchpoints: - HRIS/payroll (links to VS-19.2/VS-29.2); document management (W3333); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: HRSS team process HR transactions: employment certificates, salary certificates (for loans/visa), SSS/Pag-IBIG/PhilHealth certifications (links to VS-102 W3314), reference checks (with consent), and government verifications
HRSS team validate data against HRIS/payroll (links to VS-19.2/VS-29.2), obtain required approvals, control authorization (prevent fraudulent letters), and apply privacy consent (links to VS-91)
HRSS team issue via secure channel, capture in the employee record (W3333), and report transaction volumes and turnaround (W3336)

fields.Participants: HRSS team, HRBP, IT (links to VS-27/VS-99), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Facilities (links to VS-20.3/VS-07.2)

workflows.name: Employee Lifecycle Event Service (Onboarding/Change/Separation Ticket Execution)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-update of "HRSS team execute change events" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "HRSS team execute separation service ticket" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-538 (ensure controlled execution — HR Shared Services & Employee/Manager Self-Service Operations (PA-103.1).)
- operational: timely deprovisioning; operational: access (links to VS-27); operational: checklist and SLA
Pain Points / Risks: - **Access-leak risk**: Departed employees retain system access (links to VS-27.3); mitigated by timely deprovisioning
- **Day-1-readiness risk**: Poor onboarding service harms early experience (W3337); mitigated by checklist and SLA
System Touchpoints: - HRIS/lifecycle (links to VS-29.2); IT access/equipment (links to VS-27/VS-99); payroll (links to VS-19.2); facilities (links to VS-07.2)

steps.activity: HRSS team execute the onboarding service ticket: system access provisioning (links to VS-27/VS-99), equipment (links to VS-99.1), uniform/facilities (links to VS-07.2), payroll/benefits setup (links to VS-19.2/VS-102), and day-1 readiness (links to VS-19.1/W3337)

HRSS team execute change events (transfer, promotion, entity move): update HRIS/payroll (links to VS-19.2/VS-29.2), reconfigure access/equipment/benefits, and coordinate inter-entity transfer (links to VS-72)

HRSS team execute separation service ticket: access deprovisioning (links to VS-27.3/VS-99), equipment recovery (links to VS-99.1), final pay coordination (links to VS-19.5 W643), and offboarding logistics; ensure timely and secure closure

fields.Participants: HRSS team, CHRO, BI (links to VS-28.1), Entity HR

workflows.name: HR Service Center SLA, Quality & CSAT Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "backlog, aging, reopen rate" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify training/knowledge gaps" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "HR Shared Services Mgr report service performance to CHRO" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-123 (ensure HR service delivery & people-data accuracy.)
- operational: monitoring and staffing; operational: QA sampling and coaching
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA-breach risk**: Missed SLAs erode employee trust; mitigated by monitoring and staffing
- **Quality-decline risk**: Volume pressure degrades accuracy; mitigated by QA sampling and coaching
System Touchpoints: - Case analytics (links to VS-28.1); CSAT survey; quality tooling

steps.activity: HR Shared Services Mgr track SLA performance (first-response, resolution time, backlog, aging, reopen rate) by category/entity; capture CSAT after each case and periodic pulse
HR Shared Services Mgr conduct quality assurance: sample cases for accuracy/compliance/privacy (links to VS-91), coach agents, and identify training/knowledge gaps (W3331)
HR Shared Services Mgr report service performance to CHRO and entity HR, drive continuous improvement (W3352), and benchmark to service-center standards
